settings.title: Experience from kills
settings.description: Multiplier for experience gained by killing monsters. 1 is normal.

settings.title: Experience from quests
settings.description: Multiplier for experience gained from quests.

settings.title: Experience from daily / dungeon-finder quests
settings.description: Multiplier for experience from Dungeon Finder quests.

settings.title: Experience from exploring
settings.description: Multiplier for experience from discovering new areas.

settings.title: Item drop rate
settings.description: Multiplier for how often normal-quality items drop.

settings.title: Gold drop rate
settings.description: Multiplier for gold dropped by monsters.

settings.title: Honor gain
settings.description: Multiplier for honor points earned.

settings.title: Reputation gain
settings.description: Multiplier for reputation earned.

settings.title: Rested bonus while playing
settings.description: Speed at which rested experience is used up while you play.

settings.title: Monster damage
settings.description: Multiplier for damage dealt by normal monsters. Changes difficulty a lot.

settings.title: Monster health
settings.description: Multiplier for health of normal monsters. Changes difficulty a lot.

settings.title: Maximum players
settings.description: How many players can be online at once. 0 means no limit.

settings.title: Realm type
settings.description: The realm type shown in the realm list.

settings.title: Realm zone
settings.description: The realm's language / region group shown to clients.

settings.title: Autosave interval
settings.description: How often player characters are saved while online.

settings.title: Characters per account
settings.description: Maximum characters an account can have across all realms.

settings.title: Characters per realm
settings.description: Maximum characters an account can have on this realm.

settings.title: Starting level
settings.description: Level new characters start at.

settings.title: Starting gold
settings.description: Copper new characters start with (10000 copper = 1 gold).

settings.title: Maximum level
settings.description: Highest level a character can reach. The game client only supports 80.

settings.title: Skip intro cinematics
settings.description: Whether new characters see their intro movie.

settings.title: Durability lost on death
settings.description: Percent of item durability lost when you die.

settings.title: Resurrection sickness up to level
settings.description: Characters above this level get resurrection sickness. -10 turns it off.

settings.title: Leave group on logout
settings.description: Players are removed from their group when they log out.

settings.title: GM mode at login
settings.description: Whether game masters start with GM mode on.

settings.title: Both factions on one account
settings.description: One account may have Alliance and Horde characters.

settings.title: Cross-faction chat
settings.description: Alliance and Horde players can talk to each other.

settings.title: Automatic announcements
settings.description: Broadcast the messages stored in the database at regular intervals.

settings.title: Announcement interval
settings.description: Time between automatic announcements.

settings.title: Anti-cheat (Warden)
settings.description: Enables the client anti-cheat check. Usually unnecessary on a private server.

settings.title: Map update interval
settings.description: How often the world updates maps. Lower is smoother but uses more CPU.

settings.title: CPU cores for the world
settings.description: How many processor cores the world uses to update maps. Companions spread over several maps run much faster with more than one. Takes effect when the world server restarts.

settings.title: Minimum world update time
settings.description: Shortest time between world updates. Raise it to reduce CPU use.

settings.title: Worker threads
settings.description: Number of background worker threads. More helps large populations.

settings.title: Network threads
settings.description: Threads that handle player connections. One is enough for small servers.

settings.title: Remote console
settings.description: Lets the Manager and scripts send commands to the server. It only listens on this computer; keep it that way.

settings.title: Remote console address
settings.description: Address the remote console listens on. Keep 127.0.0.1 so it is not reachable from the internet.

settings.title: Automatic database updates
settings.description: Lets the server change its own databases at start. Keep 0: the Manager applies and tracks database updates safely.
